analysis.subject: computing
analysis.pageCoverage: The page covers the 2.0 update to the cybersecurity framework first released in 2014, its expanded scope to all organizations, new governance focus, six core functions including Govern, and new resources such as quick-start guides and a catalog referencing more than 50 documents.

overview.headline: Cybersecurity framework 2.0 expands governance and support for all organizations

keyPoints.point: Students learn that the framework now helps all organizations, not just critical infrastructure, manage and reduce risks.
keyPoints.quote: now explicitly aims to help all organizations — not just those in critical infrastructure

keyPoints.point: Students learn that governance means senior leaders treat cybersecurity as enterprise risk alongside finance and reputation.
keyPoints.quote: cybersecurity is a major source of enterprise risk that senior leaders should consider alongside others such as finance and reputation

keyPoints.point: Students learn the core now includes six functions that together form a life cycle for managing cybersecurity risk.
keyPoints.quote: The framework’s core is now organized around six key functions: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover

keyPoints.point: Students learn the catalog cross-references guidance to more than 50 other cybersecurity documents.
keyPoints.quote: cross-reference the CSF’s guidance to more than 50 other cybersecurity documents

keyTerms.gloss: organizational governance that shapes strategy and informed decisions for cybersecurity
keyTerms.quote: with added emphasis on governance as well as supply chains

keyTerms.gloss: external supply chains that affect cybersecurity risk and need protection
keyTerms.quote: organizations seeking to secure their supply chains

keyTerms.gloss: tailored quick-start guides that help specific audiences implement the framework
keyTerms.quote: quick-start guides aimed at specific audiences

keyTerms.gloss: searchable informative references that cross-reference guidance to other documents
keyTerms.quote: a searchable catalog of informative references that allows users to cross-reference the framework’s guidance

keyTerms.gloss: enterprise risk that senior leaders consider alongside finance and reputation
keyTerms.quote: cybersecurity is a major source of enterprise risk that senior leaders should consider alongside others such as finance and reputation

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: The framework presents six functions as a life cycle, so ordering them helps students recall the progression and place governance within it.
componentPlan.focusQuote: The framework’s core is now organized around six key functions: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover

componentPlan.pedagogicalReason: The page groups tailored resources and audiences, so sorting examples builds ability to match support materials to organizational needs.
componentPlan.focusQuote: such as small businesses, enterprise risk managers, and organizations seeking to secure their supply chains
